changelog: - **The plan's project cap is enforced, not just displayed** (#2273). `orgPlans.maxProjects` (FREE 3, PRO 25, ENTERPRISE unlimited) had been declared since #547 and read by exactly one thing — the usage gauge on `/admin/organizations` — so `POST /api/projects` never checked it. #2270 then opened project creation to the largest role population there is (MENTEE), which turned unbounded growth per tenant from theoretical into the default; the per-user rate limit added there is a brake, not a quota (its default counter is an in-process Map that resets on redeploy and is not shared across replicas). `checkProjectLimit()` joins `checkActiveRelationLimit()` in `src/lib/planGate.ts`, counting through the new `countOrgProjects()` in `src/lib/metering.ts` so the gate and the gauge read the same number from the same file (#1750's rule) — every project counts, whatever its status, exactly as the gauge counts them. The refusal is a 403 under its **own** code `project_limit_reached` rather than the relation gate's `plan_limit_reached`, because `mentorshipAssignmentError` maps that code to a sentence about active mentorships and would translate a refused project into "you have too many mentees"; the project form renders the new code from the dictionary in EN/TR/DE instead of echoing the server's English literal. Fails open when no org resolves and when the plan is unlimited, so the grandfathered ENTERPRISE `default` org is untouched — asserted, along with the FREE refusal, in `e2e/plan-limit-gate.spec.ts`.

en: Your plan's project allowance is now actually enforced when a project is created — Free plans get 3, Pro 25, Enterprise unlimited.
Hitting it refuses only the new project and says how many you are using out of how many; everything you already have keeps working, and archiving or upgrading frees room.
tr: Planınızdaki proje hakkı artık proje oluştururken gerçekten uygulanıyor — Free 3, Pro 25, Enterprise sınırsız.

Sınıra gelindiğinde yalnızca yeni proje reddediliyor ve kaç haktan kaçını kullandığınız yazılıyor; mevcut projeleriniz olduğu gibi çalışmaya devam ediyor, arşivlemek ya da planı yükseltmek yer açıyor.
de: Das Projektkontingent Ihres Tarifs wird beim Anlegen jetzt tatsächlich durchgesetzt — Free 3, Pro 25, Enterprise unbegrenzt.
Wird es erreicht, scheitert nur das neue Projekt, mit der Angabe wie viele von wie vielen belegt sind; bestehende Projekte bleiben unberührt, und Archivieren oder ein höherer Tarif schafft Platz.
